audience: One person managing personal todos on a phone browser and a laptop browser
primary_task: Switch to a list, add a todo, and tick it done
representative_content: Lists Inbox (Buy milk, Call bank - done), Work (Send report), Home (empty)

directions.name: Tabs on top
directions.composition: Horizontal list tabs above filter, add form and todos
directions.benefit: One tap to switch lists, everything visible

directions.name: List picker
directions.composition: Menu button opens a list panel on phone; persistent sidebar on laptop
directions.benefit: Scales to many lists and keeps the main column focused
directions.tradeoff: Switching lists on phone takes an extra tap

directions.name: Grouped page
directions.composition: Single scrolling page with a collapsible section per list

reason: Owner selected B; it scales as the owner adds lists and keeps the phone screen focused on one list
avoid: Hidden gestures, icon-only controls without labels, modal dialogs for adding todos
narrow: Below 720px the panel is a toggled menu under the top bar; content is one column with no horizontal scroll at 320px
wide: At 720px and above the panel is a fixed left sidebar and the toggle is hidden
focus: Menu toggle sets aria-expanded; Escape closes and returns focus; focus stays on the add input after adding
motion: None required; respect prefers-reduced-motion for any panel transition
browser_evidence: G_BROWSER drives Chromium at 375px and 1280px: picker, add, complete, filter, list create/rename/delete

states.error: Status region shows the problem and the draft stays in the input
states.confirm: Deleting a list asks for confirmation naming its todo count
